description: This file contains startup configuration classes for the OrchardCore Notifications module, including service registrations, feature-specific startup classes, and endpoint setup.

classes.name: Startup
classes.description: Main startup class configuring notification services and endpoints.

classes.name: WorkflowsStartup
classes.description: Configures workflow-related notification activities, enabled with 'OrchardCore.Workflows' feature.

classes.name: UsersWorkflowStartup
classes.description: Configures user content owner notification activity, enabled with 'OrchardCore.Workflows', 'Users', and 'Contents' features.

classes.name: EmailNotificationsStartup
classes.description: Configures email notification method provider, enabled with 'OrchardCore.Notifications.Email' feature.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Registers services for notifications, migrations, indexing, permissions, display drivers, and feature-specific activities.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Sets up routing endpoints, specifically adding a 'MarkAsRead' endpoint for notifications.
